name: Ashveil Peak
desc: A place where lies Kipumaki Cliff — a cliff perpetually shrouded in dark clouds, said to contain a sealed and undying fiend.

imgDesc.text:
"Twice shall that undying serpent rise again, but thrice shall he be struck down..."
"And at last shall he be laid to rest by the heroes of the sublunary sphere..."
A colossal, lidless eye it was, its gaze unflinching, piercing through the clouds, the mist, the land, and the mountains alike. It was a vision both omniscient and omnipresent.

Here echo the voices of heroic spirits: the hunters of the far north, the champions of rebellion, and the torch-bearing warriors of generations past. Though the blood of those warriors has long since dried and their deeds have faded into history, the songs of praise shall never fall silent, and their noble names shall never be forgotten.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd780>January 10, 2026</color>
At the northern edge of Nod-Krai stands the foremost front line. The Wild Hunt is closing in. But the glow from the sacred pillar has awakened the very will of the land itself, and the grass and the trees are now soldiers, as all things rise in a mighty roar, ready to defend their homeland...
Let's feel the power of nature's fight against the Abyss together!

<color=#ffd780>January 11, 2026</color>
Today, let's turn our attention to the various factions that are present in the northern part of Nod-Krai. Here, you will find the Knights of Favonius, the Lightkeepers' headquarters, and even the Hexenzirkel...
And let's not forget the powerful local legends, who have chosen to reside here for various reasons...
Just what are they all after here? Let's find out!

<color=#ffd680>January 18, 2026</color>
It's been 5 days since the new area was made available. So, dear Traveler, how many secrets have you discovered here so far?
Where Reed Miller's treasure is hidden, the Royal Court of the Seelie, and the Abyss-plagued Kipumaki Cliff... There are adventures aplenty wherever you look, whether in the air, on the ground, or even underground!
Let's take a look at the mysterious World Quests that await in the new area!

customize.name: Winter Icelea
customize.desc: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.

customize.name: Pine Amber
customize.desc: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.

customize.name: Mask of the Virtuous Doctor
customize.desc:
A mask found in the heretical testing grounds after defeating the false god that usurped the moon.
Medicine is meant to cure the ailments of the flesh, yet mortal physicians turn a blind eye to the true causes of death. In the hands of a wise healer, the frail human body escapes the bounds of birth, aging, sickness, and death, revealing strength that defies common sense.

customize.name: Madman's Restraint
customize.desc:
A band found in the heretical testing grounds after defeating the false god that usurped the moon.
Humanity defines civilization by driving out madness. Yet believing that all things, whether they exist or not, can be contained within reason may itself be another form of lunacy. The madman sees through reason's cunning, and in his world, all things are permitted.

customize.name: Elixir of the Heretic
customize.desc:
A vial found in the heretical testing grounds after defeating the false god that usurped the moon.
For centuries, self-proclaimed scholars have crawled beneath the weight of the six cardinal prohibitions, their studies little more than circular reasoning and empty words. The pursuit of truth should know no bounds — by this measure, those condemned as heretics by the world are the truest seekers of knowledge.

customize.name: Remnant of the Dreadwing
customize.desc:
A deep-black bone relic taken from the lingering corruption left behind after defeating the Whisperer of Nightmares that came invading from beyond this world.
The formless beast that soared through the starless void should never have required organs this world calls "wings." Those grotesque, profane appendages may have arisen to adapt to the laws beneath the moon, or perhaps they are merely the distorted fragment of its true form that mortal eyes are able to witness.

customize.name: Luna Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Nod-Krai to search for nearby treasures and relevant clues.
This sublunary sphere holds countless unknown treasures, waiting to be discovered by adventurers with courage or wit.

customize.name: Irismoon Seal
customize.desc:
Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Ashveil Peak.

You found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

customize.name: The Doctor
customize.desc:
Reviled far and wide as a heretic, The Doctor — Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers — has seized the authority of the three moons and now ascends the long steps toward the divine throne of the "new world."
All should have belonged to us.
But reason cast out all that exceeded its limits, leaving humanity blind to its true nature.
Life and death bound us into mortal shells, shackling every spark of aspiration.
Time and space closed in last of all, fencing the mind into meek obedience, so no one would dare imagine breaking free.
From that point on, false gods governed the world, each one declaring their own truth as the sole, unassailable gospel — though none deserved the mantle they so loudly coveted.
There is no inherent structure to life's flow — order was merely imposed upon it. Strip away every shackle laid across this world, and the essence of all things will at last come into view.
And that revelation... is the first light of the new world.
"How much longer will you continue to suffer this stagnant, obsolescent world?"

customize.name: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares
customize.desc:
An Abyssal creature that creeps through rifts in the hidden depths, quietly watching this world. Its eerie, faceless form is said to be nothing more than a projection, for its true body exists only as a formless mass of pure Abyssal energy.
Even invaders who seek to claim this world must obey its rules to some extent. Unless the heavens split open and the earth's defenses collapse, these star-born outsiders can do little more than linger at the world's fringes, whispering their madness into this realm, their attempts to seep inside amounting to nothing... But how long can this stability and order truly last?

customize.name: Gilded Sunshard: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Geo, resulting in its present form.
Just about its entire body is covered by the accumulated Geo, while its tough antlers gleam with the luster of polished amber.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Surging Currents: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Hydro, resulting in its present form.
Its clear, glass-like body is composed almost entirely of the purest water droplets. Though gentler than most of its kin, once provoked it can instantly shape the surrounding water into razor-sharp blades capable of piercing any unwary intruder's defenses.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Oprichniki Fireblade Shock Trooper
customize.desc:
An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in close combat using a giant blade.
Whether it be in the war against the dark calamity or against those ignoramuses who dare stand against the Tsaritsa's ideals, those who breach at the tip of the spear suffer the greatest casualties. As such, those who survive multiple battles are naturally the elite of the elite. There will always be those willing to become the fire and sword of the empire, just as there will always be those who chafe against the injustice of fate and the inequity of the Old World.

customize.name: Oprichniki Thunderblitz Gvardiya
customize.desc:
An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in using twin guns in combat.
Unlike their Skirmisher cousins, Oprichniki officers almost all hail from the Snezhnaya Royal Military Academy, whether due to the privilege of noble birth or the rare talent to escape a common background. After all, neither is truly different from the other within the Tsaritsa's beneficent, loving ideals. Traditionally, only fae could become elite Gvardiya, but today, this glorious role and title has been given to Oprichniki officers — a more equal division for the construction of a new world.

customize.name: Oprichniki Bombardier
customize.desc:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a specialized hover pack and explosive charges, and tasked with performing breaching operations.
As troops with immense breakthrough potential, bombardiers are often sent to the most dire of battlefields, making them the troops who gain meritorious promotions most quickly. It is said that Oprichniki officers overwhelmingly come from the ranks of the bombardiers.

customize.name: Oprichniki Medic
customize.desc:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a staff-like device and tasked with providing emergency medical support to their comrades in arms.
In truth, these medics have largely only taken crash-course training, and as such, their healing abilities are limited. In practice, they tend to adopt more efficient methods of supporting their allies — mixing in with the different units and charging at the enemy lines.

customize.name: Oprichniki Vanguard
customize.desc:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with engineering tools and highly adept in close-range combat.
To meet the demands of battlefield operations, the Fatui Oprichniki established vanguard units, tasked with clearing the path of obstacles for advancing forces. As for exactly what counts as an obstacle, that hardly matters. Be it an impassable ravine or a formidable foe standing in their way, they will remove it without hesitation — whatever it takes to ensure the banner of the Pale Star marches on.

customize.name: Oprichniki Grenadier
customize.desc:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a man-portable grenade launcher that can perform close-range bombardment.
Though the Oprichniki has large-scale, fully-functional fire support attachments, the commanding staff still advocates for large numbers of grenadiers to be maintained. After all, no big gun can compare in surety at the very front lines of combat to a grenade launcher you can direct at will.

customize.name: Oprichniki Support Trooper
customize.desc:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a heavy shield and tasked to fight at the very front to protect their comrades.
Many understand that in the long war between Snezhnaya and the dark calamity, only the side that holds out with greater resolution can outlast the other and emerge victorious. The ultimate resolution of the Oprichniki is, undoubtedly, the shield that protects their forces — so long as this shield does not fall, there is always hope for victory.

customize.name: Oprichniki Line Trooper
customize.desc:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a gunblade and tasked to hold the line as the resilient backbone of the Oprichniki forces.
According to Snezhnayan infantry manuals, the primary duties of line troops are merely to aim, shoot, and charge. Even should the individual soldier's combat power not prove exceptional, soldiers of the line in tight formation remain a key foundation of the Snezhnayan military machine.

customize.name: Wilderness Exile
customize.desc:
A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.
All who dwell beneath the moon set out on journeys with their own goals and wishes in mind, but not all such wishes receive favor. Spirits that cannot rest due to engendered resentment, partings with loved ones, or desires that go unfulfilled, if corrupted by the Abyss, may transform into ghouls, forever lost in the thick mists of the Wild Hunt.

customize.name: Fisher of Hidden Depths
customize.desc:
An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world.
Long ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."

customize.name: Hazelnut Wood
customize.desc: Wood sourced from the Hazelnut Tree. Though the subspecies this wood comes from vary wildly in appearance, they mostly share the same unique compounds that offer excellent resistance to insects and decay, making it a remarkably durable material.

customize.name: Alder Wood
customize.desc: Wood from the Alder Tree. It demonstrates considerable resistance to moisture and cold, making it a fine raw material for both furniture and musical instruments.

customize.name: Kuzmich
customize.desc: A traveling merchant from Snezhnaya.

customize.name: The Things That Coexist With Kuuvahki...
Overflowing Abyssal Power...
customize.desc: Due to its proximity to the "border" of the world, ominous and unpredictable forces seep through the Abyssal rifts and spill forth onto the land of Nod-Krai.

customize.name: Kipumaki Cliff Where the Wild Hunt Lurks...
